hello.text: Vale. Corin Vale. Best tracker in the vale, ask anyone. Ask Gil. No, don't ask Gil.

choices.text: What have you got for sale?

t0.text: Bears in the south wood. Big as a cart. Bigger. I took one with a knife once. A small knife.

t1.text: Bess says I can't bring in eight bear claws before the month's out. I say I can. You say you'll help me. We both win.
